disposition_reason: Tables 3-6 print per-package concentrations of 19 elements, including arsenic, cadmium and lead, in 27 retail edible insect, scorpion and tarantula samples bought in France and online.

study.design: pilot market survey and ICP-MS method validation; 27 packages of 12 insect, scorpion and tarantula types
study.origin: as labeled per package: France (Toulouse), Netherlands, EU, Thailand, Colombia, or not stated; life stage and origin often unavailable
study.method: closed-vessel microwave HNO3 digestion; ICP-MS/MS (Agilent 8900), 19 elements
study.lod_text: not printed in the main text (validation in Table S1)
study.qa: three insect CRMs (BFLY-1 black soldier fly larvae meal, KRIK-1 cricket flour, VORM-1 mealworm powder), recoveries mostly 90-110%; Co, K and Se in BFLY-1 differed from certified values
